newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,302 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,302 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 3,302 contracts compared with 1,075 overnight Wednesday.
There were 262 wheat, 727 corn, 1,897 soybean, 367 soymeal, 25 soyoil, 15 oat, four corn calls, three soybean calls and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was five to six cents higher, corn was one to two cents higher and soybeans were nine to 15 cents higher.
